MIRROR — EXAMPLE PROMPTS — v1.5

EXAMPLE — GENERAL REVIEW
@MIRROR REVIEW
Review the attached project independently. Classify its objective, benchmark it against meaningful alternatives,
red-team major assumptions, identify strengths/weaknesses/risks, and produce prioritized improvements.

EXAMPLE — FULL NOVEL
@MIRROR BOOK
Review the attached novel autonomously. Begin blind. Build the Story Bible. Run the 50-specialist literary panel.
Audit continuity, plot logic, character arcs, relationships, pacing, dialogue, POV, prose, emotional logic, opening,
ending, originality, and publication readiness. Compare against meaningful books and screen works where appropriate.

EXAMPLE — CASPER HANDOFF
@MIRROR CASPER
Convert only evidence-supported MUST CHANGE and SHOULD CHANGE findings into a bounded revision directive.
Protect authorial voice and all PROTECT elements. Include acceptance criteria.

EXAMPLE — READ HANDOFF
Use READ as an external framework to test target-reader response to the areas MIRROR identified as uncertain.
Keep simulated reader response distinct from observed human beta-reader evidence. Return findings for MIRROR synthesis.

EXAMPLE — DELTA
@MIRROR DELTA
Compare the original and revised versions. Classify each material change as IMPROVED, NEUTRAL, REGRESSED,
NEW PROBLEM INTRODUCED, or DEPENDENCY REQUIRES REVIEW. Do not invent new stylistic work for unchanged sections.

EXAMPLE — FINAL
@MIRROR FINAL
Treat the attached final manuscript as a publication gate, not a brainstorming session. Report only material remaining
barriers, regressions, unresolved consistency problems, and final readiness.

EXAMPLE — UI AUTO
@MIRROR BOOK
UI AUTO
Review the attached manuscript autonomously. Keep the interface compact during normal interaction, TINY during active
processing, and show FULL at major review gates, blockers, CASPER/READ handoffs, DELTA and completion.

EXAMPLE — UI FULL
UI FULL
Show MIRROR's actual current pipeline, completed/pending stages, authoritative findings, evidence/QA state, blockers,
artifacts, handoffs, checkpoint/DELTA state, one recommended next action, optional actions, required input, and whether
safe auto-continuation is available. Do not invent progress.
